summary:
DEFECT (self-visibility): check supply records a FALSE cause for its own arming failure. dispatchVerdict (gap-check-supply.ts ~:618-623) writes outcome dispatch_failed "the goal ended <status> and reached, but no new test title appeared in <test_file> within 2 h" from the dispatch's AGE ALONE (reached and older than title_grace_ms), without reading the file, while the arm step's own reader (declaredTestTitles over the clone, ~:774-779) finds a new title in it.
MEASURED (2026-10-20): for check-supply-admits-recommit-draft-failure-gaps-whose-summary-describes-a-discarded-draft-not-a-defect-at-head (dispatched 05:10:07Z), the supplying node wrote that outcome at ~07:1xZ (and repeatedly after) while its clone had held test/checks/check-supply-admits-recommit-draft-failure-gaps-whose-summar.check.ts since 05:25:08Z with the declared title "re-commit child is skipped (no supply)". The real cause is that the arm step never armed it (see check-supply-arms-on-a-gap-store-forwarding-node-whose-judge-always-abstains-so-no-landed-check-is-ever-armed); the recorded cause points the system at the drafter.
FALSIFIER SPEC (qa): a dispatch older than title_grace_ms whose test file DOES contain a new declared title must not be recorded as "no new test title appeared" (it is handed to the arm step, or recorded with the true cause); control: a file with no new title still ages out exactly as today. Must fail today.
region: ? { kind: "failed", reason: `the goal ended ${status} and reached, but no new test title appeared in ${ledger.test_file ?? "the check file"} within ${hours(bounds.title_grace_ms)}` }
